items.text: As a physician, I know how crucial it is to continue our efforts to fight stigma & work to prevent the spread of HIV. That's why I worked with Inland Behavioral & Health Services to secure over $300,000 in federal funding to invest in local services for prevention and treatment. https://t.co/KCAdk7d04L

Our police officers often suffer from PTSD, anxiety, & depression, without the necessary help to properly address it. That's why I'm calling on Congress to invest $10 million in critical funding to help officers get the treatment & support they need to live healthy lives. https://t.co/HWmCbWfVkx

Throughout the pandemic, we have seen an increase in depression, anxiety, substance abuse, and addiction disorders across our nation. That is why I voted for the #RestoringHope for Mental Health & Well-Being Act to ensure those struggling get the services and treatment they need. https://t.co/viQ6xii5tq

The passage of my bill, the Desert Sage Youth Center Access Improvement Act, is great news for the health of our Native youth. I look forward to seeing @POTUS sign this bill into law to pave a road for the residents who rely on Desert Sage's treatment. 
https://t.co/thNlAxN2bU

As the only operational @IHSgov Youth Regional Treatment Center in CA, Hemet's Desert Sage Youth Wellness Center provides culturally relevant care for our Native youth. Yesterday, the House passed my bill to improve access to this essential care. On to @POTUS to sign it into law! https://t.co/4pxqW6qigU

I am so pumped that @POTUS signed my bill to improve access to the Desert Sage Youth Wellness Center in Hemet!  1/2

https://t.co/fMxTStZcMb

After my bill to improve road access to the Desert Sage Youth Wellness Center was signed into law, I visited the health center in Hemet to celebrate the great news. Together we are securing essential mental health care and substance use disorder treatment for our Native Youth. https://t.co/eiq7V9HNLo

If you, your family, or someone in your community has been affected by the #FairviewFire and needs non-emergency treatment, call the Teladoc disaster hotline at 855-225-5032 for free, easy-to-access telehealth visits. 

https://t.co/ZFQ37Ip3Nm

Far too many American families have been destroyed by addiction and mental health issues. To end this crisis, we must #EndTheStigma surrounding mental health and substance use disorder and strive for a public health approach. 

Find resources at: https://t.co/ckcmkS6U2i https://t.co/rHyJ2gguR8

As a physician, I am committed to raising awareness and defeating the stigma around HIV/AIDS. On National Gay Men's HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, let's #StopHIVTogether with compassion and action. 

Find more information on HIV prevention and treatment here:

No veteran should experience food insecurity when transitioning back to civilian life. Last week, I voted for the Food Security for All Veterans Act, to create an Office of Food Security at the VA that will help veterans access the nutrition assistance they need. https://t.co/3ppLntqvM0

The Desert Sage Youth Wellness Center in Hemet provides crucial services to support our Native youth. That's why I worked hard to get my bill to improve access to the facility signed into law so that residents can access the care they need. 
#12DaysOfOutcomes https://t.co/91WTVAI9OX

After hearing from @EisenhowerHeal about mental wellness challenges for health workers, I introduced the Physician Wellness Program Act, which has now been signed into law as part of the 2023 funding package. It will help our doctors access essential mental health care services! https://t.co/z1miVCYmQr

Living in the desert, I know how important water is to #CA25. Today, while touring the San Jacinto Valley's wastewater treatment plant, I discussed with the @EasternMuni how we could address the current challenges, lower costs, and bring reliable, clean water to local families. https://t.co/ITtPMVW9Dk

No matter your age, reading is the best exercise for our brain and creativity. I  am so happy that last week my office joined Megan Cope Elementary School in San Jacinto to read to our students and celebrate #ReadAcrossAmerica! https://t.co/2zhL0uLJJo

Thankful to receive the @HSLegFund's 2022 Legislative Leader Award! Every effort I make to fight for legislation to advance the humane treatment of our furry companions is inspired by our communities' values. https://t.co/KvKSiCX2Da

#ICYMI: As a physician, I will always put patients first. That is why I've joined @RepBradWenstrup to introduce the bipartisan Safe Step Act to help patients get the medicine and treatment they need to live healthy, productive lives without dangerous delays. https://t.co/btvwM0JCYZ

As an emergency room physician, I have seen too often the impact late stage #cancer has on patients. This is why I am an original cosponsor of the Medicare #MCED Screening Coverage Act (H.R. 2407). These tests can and will save lives.

https://t.co/ZExnuZ0cWF

As a physician, I've fought to protect the mental health of our veterans and other high-risk communities. As we begin Mental Health Awareness Month, I remain committed to raising awareness about mental health care and wellness.

If you or a loved one is in a crisis, call/text 988 https://t.co/u0UR4SkPbr

Congrats to @easternmuni on their groundbreaking for the San Jacinto Valley Groumdwater Treatment Facility. 

This project will provide 25,000 homes in @CitySanJacinto and @hemetgov with water! https://t.co/7cGLfeQxaC

This bill will provide Medicare coverage for innovative multi-cancer early detection screening tests, improve early cancer diagnosis and save lives. As an emergency physician, I am dedicated to advancing health care every day in Congress!

Grocery prices will increase, housing construction will be delayed, hospitals and nursing homes will have fewer people to take care of patients, and hotels and restaurants will have fewer employees to serve customers. Everyone will be impacted. (4/5)

I had the honor of joining the @AmerMedicalAssn to discuss protecting Medicare access for seniors and my bill, the Strengthening Medicare for Patients and Providers Act. Let’s get it done! https://t.co/fZHKvdA8ou

Congratulations to this year’s #CA25 Congressional App Challenge winners! It’s great to see the incredible talent of our high school students, including those from Calipatria and Niland.

Their app, MedCentral, aids patients that speak a foreign language or have a disability better understand their medical condition and prescriptions. Amazing, keep innovating!
 
Check out KYMA’s coverage of the MedCentral app here: https://t.co/p0SJRrn69K

I met with Inland Empire Health Plan (#IEHP) leaders to discuss the local impacts that GOP proposed cuts to Medi-Cal would have for the people in our communities. They manage nearly 90% of all Medi-Cal patients in #Riverside and #SanBernardino Counties. They gave it to me straight and handed me a letter stating that some hospitals in my district may be forced to close.

Cutting Medi-Cal hurts everyone’s access to health care!
